title: Tanvi Sharma Secures First BWF World Tour Title, Youngest Winner Ever
indian_angle: Indian teenager Tanvi Sharma made history by becoming the youngest winner of a BWF World Tour title.
summary: Indian teenager Tanvi Sharma clinched her maiden BWF World Tour title in Chinese Taipei, winning the final in straight games and becoming the youngest champion in the tournament's history.

title: BAI Announces Eligibility Criteria for World Junior Championships 2026
indian_angle: This circular outlines the selection requirements for Indian junior players aiming to represent the country at the World Junior Championships in Cairo.
summary: Badminton Association of India (BAI) has released the player eligibility criteria for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 to be held in Cairo, Egypt.

title: Bhubaneswar U-19 Ranking Tournament Now World Junior Selection Event
indian_angle: The change in selection tournament directly affects Indian U-19 players vying for a spot in the World Junior Championships squad.
summary: The Haryana U-19 Ranking Tournament has been postponed, with the Bhubaneswar U-19 Ranking Tournament now declared as the sole selection event for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System in Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This new scoring system will be implemented across all U-13, U-15, and U-17 domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.

title: Grassroot Coaches Development Program Launched in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This program aims to enhance the skills of grassroots coaches across India, fostering future badminton talent.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) is conducting a Coaches Development Program at the Grassroot Level in NCE Guwahati and Raipur from July 15th to 24th, 2026.

title: BAI Invites EOI for World Championships 2026 Hosting
indian_angle: India is exploring the possibility of hosting the prestigious BWF World Championships in 2026, a significant event for Indian badminton.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has issued an Expression of Interest (EOI) for organizing the BWF World Championships 2026, signaling India's potential bid to host the premier global event.
